import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,re,hashlib,subprocess,sys,pathlib,collections
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/expanded-corpus-r530/'
al=json.load(open(L+'historical-results-allowlist.json',encoding='utf-8'))
base='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/'
ids=[360008,354425,349982,352895,347350,342048,344707,338173,336679,381308,352894,325848,372582,381174,320444,318354,370721,370433,370850,358196]
urls=['2309.11590','2204.13417','2103.02467','2112.05649','2007.12797','1903.02866','1912.00663','1801.02910','1707.06677','1608.04547','1307.1188','2601.10561','1308.4718','1009.5357','0903.3767','2510.01805','2509.15351','2510.07237','2304.13173']
prot=['code-loop','codeloop','code_loop','loop','polynexus','crown','tournament','bunkbed','hat','formal','r395','r463','r466','r482','r531','quarantine','lean']
idre=re.compile(r'(?<![0-9])('+'|'.join(str(i) for i in ids)+r')(?![0-9])')
urlre=re.compile('|'.join(re.escape(u) for u in urls))
skipped=[];checked=[];hits=collections.defaultdict(list);bad=[]
for p,sha in al.items():
    rel=p[len(base):] if p.startswith(base) else p
    parts=pathlib.PurePath(rel).parts
    lower=[x.lower() for x in parts]
    if any(any(t in x for t in prot) for x in lower):
        skipped.append(rel); continue
    try:
        bs=open(p,'rb').read()
    except Exception as e:
        bad.append((rel,repr(e))); continue
    h=hashlib.sha256(bs).hexdigest()
    ok=(h==sha)
    txt=bs.decode('utf-8','replace')
    m=sorted(set(idre.findall(txt)))
    u=sorted(set(urlre.findall(txt)))
    checked.append(dict(rel=rel,ok=ok,size=len(bs),ids=m,urls=u))
inv=dict(total=len(al),checked=len(checked),skipped=len(skipped),bad=bad,hash_mismatch=[c['rel'] for c in checked if not c['ok']],with_hits=[c for c in checked if c['ids'] or c['urls']],skipped_names=skipped[:400])
t=json.dumps(inv,indent=0,sort_keys=True)+'\n'
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'write_lane.py','history-access-inventory.json'],input=t,text=True,capture_output=True)
print('write',r.returncode,r.stderr[:200])
print({k:(v if not isinstance(v,list) else len(v)) for k,v in inv.items() if k!='skipped_names' and k!='with_hits'})
print('hits:')
for c in inv['with_hits']:
    print(c['rel'][:150],c['ids'][:20],c['urls'][:8],c['size'])
